title: Evolutionary System Prompt Learning for Reinforcement Learning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2602.14697v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Building agentic systems that can autonomously self-improve from experience is a longstanding goal of AI. Large language models (LLMs) today primarily self-improve via two mechanisms: self-reflection for context updates, and reinforcement learning (RL) for weight updates. In this work, we propose Evolutionary System Prompt Learning (E-SPL), a method for jointly improving a model's experiential context and its weights. In each RL iteration, E-SPL samples trajectories under multiple system prompts in parallel, then uses them to jointly update the weights with RL and evolve the system prompts with self-reflection. E-SPL encourages a natural division between procedural knowledge in weights and interpretable declarative knowledge in system prompts. Most notably, in an easy-to-hard generalization setting (AIME $\rightarrow$ BeyondAIME), E-SPL improves RL success rate from 38.8% $\rightarrow$ 45.1%. E-SPL also improves RL on AIME 2025 (56.3

translated_title: 面向大语言模型强化学习的进化式系统提示学习
translated_abstract: 构建能够从经验中自主自我改进的智能体系统是人工智能长期以来的目标。如今，大语言模型（LLM）主要通过两种机制进行自我改进：通过自我反思进行上下文更新，以及通过强化学习（RL）进行权重更新。在本工作中，我们提出了进化式系统提示学习（E-SPL），这是一种联合改进模型经验上下文及其权重的方法。在每次强化学习迭代中，E-SPL 在多个系统提示下并行采样轨迹，然后利用这些轨迹通过强化学习联合更新权重，并通过自我反思进化系统提示。E-SPL 促进了权重中的程序性知识与系统提示中可解释的陈述性知识之间的自然分工。最值得注意的是，在由易到难的泛化设置中（AIME → BeyondAIME），E-SPL 将强化学习的成功率从 38.8% 提升至 45.1%。E-SPL 还提升了强化学习在 AIME 2025 上的表现（56.3……
tldr: 本文提出进化式系统提示学习（E-SPL），在强化学习迭代中联合优化模型权重与系统提示，实现权重中程序性知识与提示中可解释陈述性知识的自然分工，显著提升大语言模型在数学推理任务上的成功率与由易到难的泛化能力。
